import bpy,json,hashlib,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
from collections import Counter
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent;cap=root/'captures/shipyard_facade_ground_20261116'
craft=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
assert not bpy.data.is_dirty
def digest(o):
 h=hashlib.sha256();h.update(np.array(o.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64).tobytes())
 if o.type=='MESH':
  for attr,size,prop in [(o.data.vertices,3,'co'),(o.data.loops,1,'vertex_index')]:
   a=np.empty(len(attr)*size,np.float64 if prop=='co' else np.int32);attr.foreach_get(prop,a);h.update(a.tobytes())
  for uv in o.data.uv_layers:
   a=np.empty(len(uv.data)*2,np.float32);uv.data.foreach_get('uv',a);h.update(a.tobytes())
  h.update(json.dumps([m.name if m else '' for m in o.data.materials]).encode())
 return h.hexdigest()
rows=[]
for o in craft.objects:
 pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
 rows.append({'name':o.name,'type':o.type,'min':[round(min(v[i] for v in pts),5) for i in range(3)],'max':[round(max(v[i] for v in pts),5) for i in range(3)],'location':list(o.location),'rotation':list(o.rotation_euler),'scale':list(o.scale),'verts':len(o.data.vertices) if o.type=='MESH' else None,'materials':[m.name for m in o.data.materials if m] if hasattr(o.data,'materials') else [],'hash':digest(o),'modifiers':[[m.name,m.type,getattr(m,'width',None)] for m in o.modifiers]})
(cap/'source_before.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
mats=Counter(m for r in rows for m in r['materials'])
print('MATERIALS',json.dumps(mats))
print('FRAMES',json.dumps([r for r in rows if any(s in r['name'].lower() for s in ['frame','window','beam','column','trim','skirt','sill','fascia','corner','door'])][:160],ensure_ascii=False))
bpy.app.driver_namespace['facade16']={'root':root,'cap':cap,'craft':craft,'digest':digest}
